text: Aoife flies to Lisbon Friday, back the following Thursday. Her first proper holiday since starting at the agency.
remind me to text Nikolai good luck the night before his interview on tuesday
Zofia got the promotion!! Team lead from next month. She was buzzing on the phone, said her mum cried.

Long chat with Yosef at the bus stop. He's retiring at Christmas after 31 years at the depot. Party is the Saturday after, at the Royal Oak. His wife Petra is already planning a cruise for the spring. I should chip in for the leaving present, Ethan's collecting.
keisha 2nd interview thurs 2pm, panel of 4. v nervous. ask how it went fri
Natasha's flight to Auckland got cancelled, so the whole trip's off now. She's gutted.
Sophie starts at the hospital on Monday. Night shifts for the first month apparently.
Yetunde mentioned her brother Tobi just got offered a job in Dubai. Moving out there in a fortnight.
Buy adaptor plugs and sort travel insurance before Wednesday.

So I bumped into Vera at the station and she said Rahul has handed his notice in, last day is next Friday, and they're doing drinks that evening at the place by the canal. She thinks he's going freelance. Need to get him a card, something funny, he hates soppy stuff.
Fern's dog Biscuit is going to her sister's while she's in Japan for three weeks.
Don't forget to ask Tomás how the first day went. It was today, I think? Or yesterday.
Kalani - applied for the deputy head job, hears back next week. Wants it badly but says she's not getting her hopes up.
Emre and Irina off to Vietnam on the 3rd, flying via Doha. Their honeymoon finally, two years late.
Karan has been struggling at the new place. Manager keeps moving the goalposts and he's not sleeping. Check in with him this weekend.
liam interview went well apparently?? second round tomorrow morning. text him that evening
Ana's mum retires Friday. Forty years teaching. Ana's doing a surprise lunch the day after.
Kwame - accountant, loves cricket, two kids. Wife is Meera. Met at Hamza's thing.
Yusuf hates flying. Takes a tablet before every long haul, even then he's a wreck.
Anil said Kiri's starting her new role at the council on Monday, and the next day she's straight off to a training course in Leeds for three nights.
Mia nervous about the presentation part of her interview Wednesday. She has to pitch to the directors. Wish her luck Tuesday night.
Hamza back from Morocco, tanned and broke. Said the riad was amazing.
Dong's last day at the bank was yesterday. Leaving do got called off because half the team had covid, so maybe take him for a pint instead.
Petra Olsen, Yosef's wife, is a retired nurse. Grows tomatoes, very into it. Mentioned she'd love a new greenhouse thermometer, hers broke.
Note to self: renew passport. Expires in March and we're going to Canada in April.
Aleksander, Alek to everyone at work, is moving to the Berlin office in January. His partner's going with him.
Check in with Zofia next week, the new team's giving her a hard time apparently.
Nikolai - interview Tues went ok, they said they'd let him know by Friday. Ask him Friday afternoon if he's heard.
Aoife's back from Lisbon. Lost her suitcase on the way home, still hasn't turned up three days later. Ring the airline for her? She said she'd do it but she's so busy with work.

right so ethan's sister has got an interview at the uni for a lecturer post, it's the week after next, and she's terrified because it's a whole day thing with a teaching demo in the morning and then the panel afterwards. ethan asked if I'd look over her slides. I'll do it on sunday
Keisha GOT IT. Starts in January. Send flowers.
Natasha and her husband are going to Greece in half term instead, since NZ fell through.
Sophie said her first week was brutal but the team's lovely. She's shattered.
Tobi flies out to Dubai on the 28th. Yetunde's hosting a send-off the Saturday before. I'm bringing dessert.
Coffee with Vera. Nothing much new, she's fine.
Rahul's leaving drinks were good. He's starting with an agency client the Monday after. Message him a week after to see how freelancing's going.
Fern got back from Kyoto Sunday, jetlagged to bits. Biscuit had a great time at her sister's apparently and doesn't want to come home.
Tomás said first day was fine but he's worried he oversold himself in the interview. Has his probation review in three months.
Kalani didn't get the deputy head job. Really flat about it. Should ask her round for dinner this week.
Spoke to Irina before they flew, Emre's lost his passport. They found it in the car that morning, panic over, but she said she aged ten years.
Karan has a meeting with HR Thursday about the manager stuff. Text him Wednesday evening, and then again Friday to see what came of it.
Liam's partner Mia just got a job offer in Edinburgh. Big decision, they'd have to move by spring.
Mrs Rossi from next door off to Sicily tomorrow for a month to see her sister. I'm feeding the cat, Pepe, and watering the plants. Key is under the blue pot.
Kwame's son is applying to medical school. Interviews in December. Kwame more nervous than the kid.
Anil is retiring!! End of the month. Says he's going to walk the Camino in May.
Dr Haddad leaving the practice next Friday after twenty years. Must sign the card at reception before then.
Meera said Hamza's been made redundant. He's putting a brave face on it but she says he's really low. Don't mention it unless he does.
Dong starts at the new firm Monday week. Asked me for tips on commuting into town, I'll send him the bus app link.
Ethan's sister's interview is Thursday. Wish her luck Wednesday. Her name's Aoife too, funnily enough.
Zofia's off to Iceland next weekend with her girlfriend for their anniversary, three nights in Reykjavik. Then she's straight into a week of training the day after they land. Mad.
Interview prep for my own thing Friday. Iron shirt Thursday night, leave by 8.
Yusuf finally got the visa for the Australia trip. Took four months. Flying out the 12th to see his grandkids for the first time.
Kiri hated the training course, said Leeds was grim and the hotel had no hot water. Back at her desk now and much happier.
Irina messaged from Hanoi, they're having the best time. Emre got food poisoning the second night but he's fine now.
Petra wants Yosef to come on the cruise but he gets seasick. Long standing family joke apparently.
Mum's friend Yetunde starting a new job as a school receptionist next week, mum said she's dead nervous about the phones. Pass on good luck when I see her Sunday.
Grocery run, then gym. Pay the electric bill tomorrow.
Sophie's brother Liam has an interview with the fire service next Tuesday, his third time applying. She's driving him there. Remind me to ask Sophie how he got on that night or the morning after.
Natasha back from Crete on Sunday. Says she's dreading going back to work Monday, the new boss started while she was away and nobody's sure about him yet. Call her Monday night.

Big catch up with Aleksander before he goes. Alek's leaving do is Friday the 9th, his last day is the Wednesday before, and he flies to Berlin the morning after the party. His mum's coming over from Gdansk for the send off. I should get him something small for the flat, he mentioned wanting a decent coffee grinder.
